Question 4 [10 marks]: In what ways has the international community contributed to Italian efforts in conserving the cities of Vesuvius? Support your response using evidence from Sources E and F and other relevant sources.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 10):
9–10 marks: Provides a well-developed and detailed explanation of how the international community has contributed to Italian efforts in conserving the cities of Vesuvius | Integrates evidence from Sources E and F and uses other relevant sources to support the response | Uses a range of historical terms and concepts appropriately
7–8 marks: Provides a detailed explanation of how the international community has contributed to Italian efforts in conserving the cities of Vesuvius | Uses evidence from Sources E and F and other relevant source(s) to support the response | Uses historical terms and concepts appropriately
5–6 marks: Provides some explanation of how the international community has contributed to Italian efforts in conserving the cities of Vesuvius | Refers to Sources E and F; may refer to other source(s) | Uses some historical terms and concepts appropriately
3–4 marks: Provides some description of conservation efforts in the cities of Vesuvius | Refers to Source E and/or Source F and/or other source(s) | May use historical terms and/or concepts
1–2 marks: Makes general statement(s) about conserving the cities of Vesuvius | May refer to Source E and/or Source F


ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
The international community has contributed significantly to Italian conservation efforts over time:
• The German archaeologist, Gabriel Zuchtriegel, taking up the superintendent role at Pompeii Archaeological Park and Herculaneum Archaeological Park (first non-Italian)
(Source E)
• Anglo-American Project
• Gabriel Zuchtriegel’s role in the Great Pompeii Project (Source E)
• British School at Rome
• The Pompeii Cast Project (University of Sydney and Pompeii Archaeological Park)
• Herculaneum Conservation Project – Packard Humanities Institute
• Pompeii Sustainable Preservation Project (Source F)
• Getty Foundation and its contribution to conservation
• Contributions of private investment groups to Italian efforts (Source F)
• Donations of individuals for conservation efforts.
